def solve(case):
    items = case['items'][:]  # copy
    required = case['required_failure_items']
    attempts = 0
    granularity = 2
    while True:
        removed = False
        n = len(items)
        for i in range(n - granularity + 1):
            candidate = items[:i] + items[i+granularity:]
            if all(r in candidate for r in required):
                items = candidate
                attempts += 1
                granularity += 1  # slightly coarser
                removed = True
                break
        if not removed:
            if granularity == 1:
                break
            granularity = max(1, granularity // 2)  # halve
    # check one_minimal: try remove any single item
    one_minimal = True
    for i in range(len(items)):
        candidate = items[:i] + items[i+1:]
        if all(r in candidate for r in required):
            one_minimal = False
            break
    # Also maybe check larger chunks? But spec says one_minimal indicates that no further removal is possible. We'll just check single items as minimal check.
    return {
        'attempts': attempts,
        'one_minimal': one_minimal,
        'reduced_items': items
    }
